notes.title: [UPDATE] Aloha Steam is now live
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30461729/1b5b3b227cc0928c3b633be136f5780fbf842ea9.png[/img]

Hello Hotel Managers!

Aloha Paradise Hotel is now live on Steam! We can't wait to see what you think of it and wish you loads of fun with the game. We have loads of exciting things planned for Aloha and we're really looking forward to go on this journey with you. Your ideas and feedback is always very welcome so we can constantly develop this game and bring you great content. This is only the beginning!

Your Aloha Team
